column6: A URL, tagged release, or demo video is provided (link the CI run when one exists); or the note says plainly that nothing works yet and why. Where a video replaces the live demo (a missed check-in, or a TA who could not meet), it is on media.oregonstate.edu, unlisted, captioned, with one timestamp per student.
column9: Item missing: no evidence and no plain statement of why nothing works yet.

column6: Links to the board and lists what the team finished, each item concrete and consequential. Non-code work counts. Activity without a result ("worked on the API", "researched options") does not.
column9: Item missing: no board link, or the list describes how time was spent rather than what now exists.

column2: Top risk and one decision needed
column6: Names the single biggest threat to shipping (the Definition of Shipped once it exists; the term gate in fall) and one concrete decision the team needs from the partner, the staff, or itself.
column9: Item missing: no top risk, or no concrete decision needed.

column6: One line per student with all three parts: the work owned (one or more pieces, each with a link or ID; NDA teams list IDs only), whose work the student reviewed and the change they asked for, and a human-written sentence on the most consequential thing they shipped and how the team knows it works. Listed work opens, was accepted this sprint, and is a real change; work in a system the grader cannot open is listed by ID and verified by the team's TA at the check-in demo. A line that truthfully says a student has nothing this sprint (the repository and the team's tracker show no owned work) needs no other part and passes. Graders check one listed piece per student.
column9: Item missing: a student has no line, a line is missing one of its three parts, or a line claims work that does not check out (it does not open and was not verified at the check-in demo, was not accepted this sprint, or is mechanical).

column6: About five human-written lines on what the team learned this sprint and what it changes about the plan; any genuine, sprint-specific content passes.
column9: Item missing: judgment layer absent, or the same text reused across sprints.
